title: Unit protection
description: RC5: the relays a generating unit carries itself (27 / 59 under / over voltage, 32 reverse power, 40 loss of excitation, 81U / 81O under / over frequency, 81R RoCoF, 78 vector shift), separate from the network's protection. A template of this kind is a unit protection class default; a generator names it with protectionTemplate (or a binding rule matches it), and a case override with a unit member sets one unit's own values on top. Resolution per setting: unit override, else the template, else absent (an absent relay is absent; nothing is invented). A stage exists when its pickup resolves and then needs its delay. Read by GridSim.Core.Protection.UnitProtectionSet (no code default: every value comes from a template, an override or a preset).

uv1Pu.description: 27 undervoltage stage 1 pickup, pu of the unit's terminal bus nominal voltage; above 0 and below 1.

uv1DelayS.description: Definite time delay of 27 stage 1 (s): the quantity must stay beyond the pickup this long. Required whenever the pickup resolves (unit value or template); refused without it.

uv2Pu.description: 27 undervoltage stage 2 pickup (pu); above 0 and below 1.

uv2DelayS.description: Definite time delay of 27 stage 2 (s): the quantity must stay beyond the pickup this long. Required whenever the pickup resolves (unit value or template); refused without it.

ov1DelayS.description: Definite time delay of 59 stage 1 (s): the quantity must stay beyond the pickup this long. Required whenever the pickup resolves (unit value or template); refused without it.

ov2DelayS.description: Definite time delay of 59 stage 2 (s): the quantity must stay beyond the pickup this long. Required whenever the pickup resolves (unit value or template); refused without it.

reversePowerPu.description: 32 reverse power pickup: the real power the unit absorbs, pu of its own rating (capacityMva); above 0 and at most 1.

reversePowerDelayS.description: Definite time delay of 32 (s): the quantity must stay beyond the pickup this long. Required whenever the pickup resolves (unit value or template); refused without it.

loe1OffsetPu.description: 40 loss of excitation zone 1: offset of the mho circle below the origin of the R-X plane, pu of the unit's own impedance base (typically X'd / 2).

loe1DiameterPu.description: 40 zone 1 mho circle diameter, pu of the unit's impedance base (typically 1.0 pu); above 0. Required with loe1OffsetPu.

loe1DelayS.description: Definite time delay of 40 zone 1 (s): the quantity must stay beyond the pickup this long. Required whenever the pickup resolves (unit value or template); refused without it.

loe2OffsetPu.description: 40 zone 2 mho offset (pu of the unit's impedance base).

loe2DiameterPu.description: 40 zone 2 mho diameter (typically Xd); above 0. Required with loe2OffsetPu.

loe2DelayS.description: Definite time delay of 40 zone 2 (s): the quantity must stay beyond the pickup this long. Required whenever the pickup resolves (unit value or template); refused without it.

uf1DelayS.description: Definite time delay of 81U stage 1 (s): the quantity must stay beyond the pickup this long. Required whenever the pickup resolves (unit value or template); refused without it.

uf2DelayS.description: Definite time delay of 81U stage 2 (s): the quantity must stay beyond the pickup this long. Required whenever the pickup resolves (unit value or template); refused without it.

of1DelayS.description: Definite time delay of 81O stage 1 (s): the quantity must stay beyond the pickup this long. Required whenever the pickup resolves (unit value or template); refused without it.

of2DelayS.description: Definite time delay of 81O stage 2 (s): the quantity must stay beyond the pickup this long. Required whenever the pickup resolves (unit value or template); refused without it.

rocofDelayS.description: Definite time delay of 81R (it resets when RoCoF falls below the pickup) (s): the quantity must stay beyond the pickup this long. Required whenever the pickup resolves (unit value or template); refused without it.

vectorShiftDeg.description: 78 vector shift pickup (deg); above 0 and below 180.

vectorShiftDelayS.description: Definite time delay of 78 (s): the quantity must stay beyond the pickup this long. Required whenever the pickup resolves (unit value or template); refused without it.

relayNominalHz.description: The nominal frequency the absolute 81U / 81O pickups are written for. Absent: 50 Hz (the GB value the ENA settings assume). On a system of another nominal the frequency stages are reported not checkable.

rocofPreset.description: ENA loss-of-mains RoCoF preset, expanding to rocofHzPerS and rocofDelayS with cited provenance: legacy = K2 x 0.125 Hz/s with K2 = 1.0 (EREC G59 Issue 3 Amendment 8 p.62 and note (2) p.63), legacy-high-impedance = K2 = 1.6 (0.2 Hz/s), both with a 0.5 s delay (S135 Table 10.5.7.1 p.62, plant commissioned before 01/02/18; S132 Table 10.5.7.1 p.63, legacy band), reset when RoCoF falls below the threshold (S135 note p.63); modern = 1 Hz/s, 0.5 s (EREC G99 Issue 2 Table 10.1 p.125). An explicit rocofHzPerS / rocofDelayS in the same template or override wins.

interfacePreset.description: EREC G99 Issue 2 Table 10.1 interface protection (Types A to C, p.125), HV or LV column: 27, 59 stages 1 and 2, 81U stages 1 and 2, 81O and 81R, all Recorded with the table cited. rocofPreset and explicit values in the same template or override win.
